local v_Il1IO10Il000 = 41
local v_lI00I0llO0l0l1l1011O = game
local function v_1Il10II0l1ll(t)
    local r = {}
    for _, b in ipairs(t) do
        
            local x = b
            local y = v_Il1IO10Il000
            local z = 0
            for i = 0, 7 do
                local p = 2 ^ i
                local x_bit = (x % (p * 2) >= p) and 1 or 0
                local y_bit = (y % (p * 2) >= p) and 1 or 0
                if x_bit ~= y_bit then z = z + p end
            end
            table.insert(r, string.char(z))
            
    end
    return table.concat(r)
end
